questions.sentence: Her ______ of the market surprised everyone.
questions.explanation: 所有格 Her 後接名詞，analysis 為名詞，故選 analysis。

questions.sentence: The new regulations will be ______ next quarter.
questions.explanation: will be + 過去分詞構成未來被動，故選 implemented。

questions.sentence: She ______ speaks English in the office.
questions.explanation: 頻率副詞 always 置於 be 動詞後、一般動詞前，此句 speaks 為一般動詞，always 放在動詞前正確。

questions.sentence: The team has been ______ on the proposal.
questions.explanation: has been + V-ing 構成現在完成進行式，故選 working。

questions.sentence: The new policy will improve ______ in the workplace.
questions.explanation: improve 為動詞，後接名詞作受詞，safety 為名詞，故選 safety。

questions.sentence: This is the ______ solution we have found.
questions.explanation: the + 最高級，三者或以上比較用最高級 best。

questions.sentence: Please ______ the data before the meeting.
questions.explanation: Please 後接動詞原形（祈使句），analyze 為動詞，故選 analyze。

questions.sentence: The new branch ______ by the end of next year.
questions.explanation: by the end of next year 表未來，主詞為被動，用未來被動 will be opened。

questions.sentence: She received ______ promotion last month.
questions.explanation: promotion 以子音音素開頭，用不定冠詞 a；表第一次提及的單數可數名詞。

questions.sentence: Please confirm ______ the report has been sent.
questions.explanation: confirm 後接名詞子句，表是否已送出，用 whether。

questions.sentence: The company is committed ______ environmental sustainability.
questions.explanation: committed to 為固定搭配，to 後接名詞或動名詞。

questions.sentence: The decision depends ______ the budget.
questions.explanation: depend on 為固定搭配，表示取決於。

questions.sentence: Water ______ at 100 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation: 科學事實用簡單現在式；主詞 Water 為第三人稱單數，故選 boils。

questions.sentence: The CEO is ______ a speech at the annual conference.
questions.explanation: is + V-ing 構成現在進行式，故選 giving。

questions.sentence: Please inform us ______ you cannot attend the meeting.
questions.explanation: 表條件（如果無法出席），用 if；although 表讓步，so that 表目的，since 表原因，皆不符。

questions.sentence: The ______ the deadline approaches, the more pressure we feel.
questions.explanation: The + 比較級…the + 比較級 句型，故選比較級 closer。

questions.sentence: She is familiar ______ the new software.
questions.explanation: familiar with 為固定搭配，表示對…熟悉。

questions.sentence: The project was ______ completed ahead of schedule.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 completed，需用副詞，successfully 為副詞，故選 successfully。

questions.sentence: We need to ______ more in staff training.
questions.explanation: need to 後接動詞原形，invest 為動詞，故選 invest。

questions.sentence: The company made a significant ______ in technology.
questions.explanation: 冠詞 a 後需接名詞，investment 為名詞，故選 investment。

questions.sentence: The package ______ arrive by Thursday at the latest.
questions.explanation: 表預期或應該，用 should；might 可能性更低，must 為強制義務，can 為能力，皆不符。

questions.sentence: The new model is ______ than the previous one.
questions.explanation: two 個比較對象用比較級，多音節形容詞用 more + 原形，故選 more efficient。

questions.sentence: The manager decided ______ the meeting.
questions.explanation: decide 後接不定詞（to + V），故選 to cancel。

questions.sentence: By the end of this year, she ______ here for five years.
questions.explanation: by the end of this year 為未來時間點，表示屆時累積完成，用未來完成式 will have worked。

questions.sentence: We are responsible ______ the quality of our products.
questions.explanation: responsible for 為固定搭配，表示對…負責。

questions.sentence: By the time she arrived, the meeting ______.
questions.explanation: by the time 引導的時間子句（arrived）用過去式，主句用過去完成式表示更早發生的事，故選 had ended。

questions.sentence: We ______ the contract as soon as possible.
questions.explanation: 表達未來意圖，用 will + 原形動詞 will sign。

questions.sentence: ______ is essential to review the contract carefully.
questions.explanation: It is + 形容詞 + to V 為虛主詞句型，真正主詞為後面的不定詞，故用 It。

questions.sentence: He is ______ honest employee.
questions.explanation: honest 以母音音素 /ɒ/ 開頭，用不定冠詞 an。

questions.sentence: The flight ______ two hours late yesterday.
questions.explanation: yesterday 表示過去，用簡單過去式 arrived。

questions.sentence: The employee ______ won the award is from our department.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為人（employee），且在關係子句中作主詞，用 who。

questions.sentence: The presentation was long ______ informative.
questions.explanation: 表對比（長但有益），用對等連接詞 but。

questions.sentence: All ______ must be submitted by Friday.
questions.explanation: All 後接可數名詞複數，applications 為複數，故選 applications。

questions.sentence: She agreed ______ the project proposal.
questions.explanation: agree 後接不定詞（to + V），故選 to review。

questions.sentence: ______ meeting we had yesterday was very productive.
questions.explanation: the 用於雙方都知道的特定事物（昨天那場會議），故選 The。

questions.sentence: ______ the meeting ends, please turn off the lights.
questions.explanation: 表示會議結束之後，用 After；until 表直到，during 表在期間，for 表一段時間，皆不符。

questions.sentence: All applications ______ by Tuesday.
questions.explanation: 主詞 applications 為被動，加上語氣助動詞 must，用 must be submitted。

questions.sentence: You ______ bring a laptop to the training session if you have one.
questions.explanation: 表建議或建議性義務，用 should；must 為強制，過強；can't 為否定能力，不符。

questions.sentence: She ______ in this company for ten years.
questions.explanation: for ten years 表示從過去持續到現在，用現在完成式 has worked。

questions.sentence: She was promoted ______ she joined the company.
questions.explanation: 表示從加入公司到現在（已晉升），用 since；after 表之後某時，before 表之前，during 表期間，皆不符。

questions.sentence: The machinery ______ since the accident.
questions.explanation: since 表示從過去到現在，主詞為被動，用現在完成被動 has been repaired。

questions.sentence: This quarter's results are ______ than expected.
questions.explanation: than 引導比較，用比較級；good 的比較級為 better，故選 better。

questions.sentence: All employees are encouraged to ______ to team discussions.
questions.explanation: be encouraged to 後接動詞原形，contribute 為動詞，故選 contribute。

questions.sentence: She ______ to the office every day.
questions.explanation: 主詞 She 為第三人稱單數，簡單現在式動詞需加 -s，故選 goes。

questions.sentence: They finished ______ the annual report.
questions.explanation: finish 後接動名詞（V-ing），故選 preparing。

questions.sentence: The report has been ______ to all department heads.
questions.explanation: has been + 過去分詞構成現在完成被動，故選 distributed。

questions.sentence: ______ the report, she found several errors.
questions.explanation: 分詞構句主詞與主句相同，表示同時進行的動作，用現在分詞 Reviewing。

questions.sentence: She completed the task ______.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 completed，需用副詞，efficiently 為副詞，故選 efficiently。

questions.sentence: By next Friday, they ______ the project.
questions.explanation: by next Friday 表示未來某時點之前動作已完成，用未來完成式 will have finished。

questions.sentence: If it ______ tomorrow, the event will be postponed.
questions.explanation: 第一條件句（真實條件）：if 子句用現在式，主句用 will，故 if 子句選 rains。

questions.sentence: Please ensure the ______ of all employees.
questions.explanation: 冠詞 the 後接名詞，safety 為名詞，故選 safety。

questions.sentence: The conference ______ place in Singapore next week.
questions.explanation: next week 表示未來，用 will take。

questions.sentence: The manager ______ team won the award gave a speech.
questions.explanation: 表所有關係，先行詞為人（manager），用 whose。

questions.sentence: He ______ the report before the deadline passed.
questions.explanation: before 子句（deadline passed）為過去，主句動作發生更早，用過去完成式 had submitted。

questions.sentence: Please refer ______ the attached document.
questions.explanation: refer to 為固定搭配，表示參考；refer for/at/with 皆不正確。

questions.sentence: If they ______ the contract earlier, they would have saved money.
questions.explanation: 第三條件句（與過去事實相反）：if 子句用過去完成式，主句用 would have，故選 had signed。

questions.sentence: They ______ for a solution all week.
questions.explanation: all week 強調持續進行至今，用現在完成進行式 have been searching。

questions.sentence: The manager ______ the report yesterday.
questions.explanation: 時間副詞 yesterday 表明過去時間，用簡單過去式 reviewed。

questions.sentence: We look forward to ______ from you soon.
questions.explanation: look forward to 中 to 為介系詞，後接動名詞，故選 hearing。

questions.sentence: He is an ______ worker.
questions.explanation: 修飾名詞 worker，需用形容詞，efficient 為形容詞，故選 efficient。

questions.sentence: The company ______ its revenue three times since 2020.
questions.explanation: since 2020 表示從過去到現在的時間段，用現在完成式 has doubled。

questions.sentence: We appreciate your ______ to this project.
questions.explanation: 所有格 your 後接名詞，contribution 為名詞，故選 contribution。

questions.sentence: The engineers ______ the equipment currently.
questions.explanation: currently 暗示此刻進行中，用現在進行式 are testing。

questions.sentence: The manager spoke ______ to the new employees.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 spoke，需用副詞，directly 為副詞，故選 directly。

questions.sentence: The team reached an ______ on the budget.
questions.explanation: 冠詞 an 後接名詞，agreement 為名詞，故選 agreement。

questions.sentence: ______ the weather was bad, the event continued.
questions.explanation: 表讓步（儘管天氣不好），用 Although；because 和 since 表原因，so 表結果，皆不符。

questions.sentence: The new policy ______ last week.
questions.explanation: last week 表過去，且主詞為被動，用過去式被動 was announced。

questions.sentence: ______ has the company achieved such remarkable growth.
questions.explanation: 否定副詞 Never before 置於句首時，句子需倒裝（助動詞前移），Never before has... 為正確倒裝結構。

questions.sentence: The team ______ on a new project right now.
questions.explanation: right now 表示此刻正在進行，用現在進行式 is working。

questions.sentence: We ______ the new software already.
questions.explanation: already 與現在完成式連用，表示已完成的動作，故選 have installed。

questions.sentence: The working environment must be ______.
questions.explanation: 連綴動詞 be 後接形容詞作主詞補語，safe 為形容詞，故選 safe。

questions.sentence: We need ______ new equipment for the lab.
questions.explanation: equipment 為不可數名詞，前面不加冠詞（或用 some）；選 no article。

questions.sentence: I ______ this movie before, so I know the ending.
questions.explanation: before 與現在完成式連用，表示過去某時有過此經歷且與現在相關，故選 have seen。

questions.sentence: Each employee must submit ______ own report.
questions.explanation: 現代英文中 each employee 可用 their 指代，避免性別預設；his or her 雖正確但較繁瑣，their 為最常用選項。

questions.sentence: The team completed the project by ______.
questions.explanation: The team 指整個團隊（複數概念），用反身代名詞 themselves。

questions.sentence: ______ he is new, he handles tasks very professionally.
questions.explanation: 表讓步（雖然是新人但表現專業），用 Although。

questions.sentence: Please wait here ______ she returns.
questions.explanation: 表示等到某事發生為止，用 until；since 表從某時起，for 表一段時間，during 表在某段期間內，皆不符。

questions.sentence: The document ______ you need is on the desk.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為物（document），在關係子句中作受詞，用 which（或 that）。

questions.sentence: She ______ be in the meeting right now; I just saw her in the lobby.
questions.explanation: 從語境推斷（剛在大廳看到她）她不可能在開會，表否定推斷用 can't。

questions.sentence: The store ______ at 9 a.m. on weekdays.
questions.explanation: 描述固定習慣，用簡單現在式；The store 為第三人稱單數，故選 opens。

questions.sentence: They ______ a meeting when the power went out.
questions.explanation: when 子句（went out）用簡單過去式，主句表示當時正在進行的動作，用過去進行式 were having。

questions.sentence: If she ______ harder, she would get a promotion.
questions.explanation: 第二條件句（假設與現實相反）：if 子句用過去式，主句用 would，故選 worked。

questions.sentence: The ______ provided in the report was inaccurate.
questions.explanation: information 為不可數名詞，無複數形；且 the 後需接名詞，故選 information。

questions.sentence: The report ______ by the manager every Friday.
questions.explanation: 主詞 report 為被動接受者，且為固定習慣，用簡單現在式被動 is reviewed。

questions.sentence: You ______ submit the form before the deadline.
questions.explanation: 表示義務或強制要求，用 must；can 表能力，might 表可能，would 表意願，皆不符。

questions.sentence: She ______ when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: when 子句用簡單過去式，主要子句用過去進行式表示當時正在進行的動作，故選 was sleeping。

questions.sentence: The new policy ______ effect next month.
questions.explanation: next month 表示未來，用 will + 原形動詞，故選 will take。

questions.sentence: This was a ______ outcome for the team.
questions.explanation: 修飾名詞 outcome，需用形容詞，successful 為形容詞，故選 successful。

questions.sentence: It was the new marketing strategy ______ boosted sales.
questions.explanation: It is/was…that… 為強調句型，強調主詞或受詞，固定用 that。

questions.sentence: She is ______ qualified for the position.
questions.explanation: 修飾形容詞 qualified，需用副詞，highly 為副詞，故選 highly。

questions.sentence: She worked overtime ______ she could finish the report.
questions.explanation: 表目的（為了能完成），用 so that；although 表讓步，because 表原因，unless 表條件，皆不符。

questions.sentence: She was ______ employee of the month.
questions.explanation: was + 過去分詞構成過去被動，named 表被命名，故選 named。

questions.sentence: ______ all the data, the team submitted the findings.
questions.explanation: 分詞構句表示主句動作之前已完成的動作，用完成分詞 Having analyzed。

questions.sentence: She ______ a presentation at this moment.
questions.explanation: at this moment 表示正在進行，用現在進行式 is preparing。

questions.sentence: The ______ of the meeting will be distributed tomorrow.
questions.explanation: meeting minutes（會議記錄）為固定複數名詞用法，故選 minutes。

questions.sentence: The equipment ______ regularly to ensure safety.
questions.explanation: 主詞 equipment 為受詞，表習慣性動作，用現在式被動 is maintained。

questions.sentence: I am not sure ______ she will attend the conference.
questions.explanation: 表不確定是否（yes/no 問題）的名詞子句用 whether；that 不帶疑問，what/which 需有對應受詞，皆不符。

questions.sentence: He ______ on this report since morning.
questions.explanation: since morning 表示從過去一直持續到現在，強調動作持續進行，用現在完成進行式 has been working。

questions.sentence: They ______ a new branch office last year.
questions.explanation: last year 為過去時間標記，用簡單過去式 opened。

questions.sentence: He suggested ______ a new supplier.
questions.explanation: suggest 後接動名詞（V-ing），故選 finding。

questions.sentence: The committee ______ a decision by next Monday.
questions.explanation: by next Monday 表未來某時點前已完成，用未來完成式 will have made。

questions.sentence: He ______ for the company since it was founded.
questions.explanation: since it was founded 表從過去到現在的持續，用現在完成式 has worked。

questions.sentence: They ______ the contract when the lawyer arrived.
questions.explanation: when 子句（arrived）用過去簡單式，主句表示當時正在進行中的動作，用過去進行式 were signing。

questions.sentence: The factory ______ over 500 units daily next year.
questions.explanation: next year 為未來時間標記，用簡單未來式 will produce。

questions.sentence: She ______ the presentation three times before it was perfect.
questions.explanation: before 子句（was perfect）用過去式，主句動作更早發生，用過去完成式 had revised。

questions.sentence: By the time you read this, I ______ the project.
questions.explanation: by the time 引導未來時間點，主句用未來完成式 will have finished。

questions.sentence: The sales figures ______ steadily for the past three months.
questions.explanation: for the past three months 表示持續到現在的動作，強調進行中，用現在完成進行式 have been increasing。

questions.sentence: She ______ the report when her computer crashed.
questions.explanation: when 子句（crashed）用過去簡單式，主句表示當時正在進行的動作，用過去進行式 was writing。

questions.sentence: The office ______ at 8 a.m. and closes at 6 p.m.
questions.explanation: 描述固定時間表，用簡單現在式；The office 為第三人稱單數，故選 opens。

questions.sentence: He ______ as a consultant before joining this company.
questions.explanation: before joining 表示比過去動作（joining）更早發生，用過去完成式 had worked。

questions.sentence: The new branch office ______ last month.
questions.explanation: last month 表過去，主詞為被動接受者，用過去被動式 was opened。

questions.sentence: All complaints ______ within 24 hours.
questions.explanation: 主詞 All complaints 為複數被動，表習慣性做法，用現在被動 are handled。

questions.sentence: The new system ______ by the IT department currently.
questions.explanation: currently 表此刻正在進行，主詞為被動，用現在進行被動 is being tested。

questions.sentence: The proposal ______ before the board meeting next week.
questions.explanation: 主詞 proposal 為被動，加義務助動詞 must，用 must be submitted。

questions.sentence: The award ______ to three employees last year.
questions.explanation: last year 表過去，give 用被動，was given to 表示頒發給…。

questions.sentence: New regulations ______ to take effect in January.
questions.explanation: 主詞為被動，表預期（被認為會…），用 are expected to V。

questions.sentence: The budget ______ by the finance team every quarter.
questions.explanation: every quarter 表固定習慣，主詞 budget 為被動，用現在被動 is reviewed。

questions.sentence: The results will ______ to all participants.
questions.explanation: will + be + 過去分詞構成未來被動式，故選 be announced。

questions.sentence: A new CEO ______ since the previous one resigned.
questions.explanation: since 引導現在完成式；主詞為被動，用現在完成被動否定 has not been appointed。

questions.sentence: The shipment ______ to arrive by Thursday.
questions.explanation: be scheduled to V 為固定被動句型，表示預定，故選 is scheduled。

questions.sentence: You ______ wear a badge at all times in the building.
questions.explanation: 表強制規定（必須），用 must；might/could 表可能，would 表意願，皆不符。

questions.sentence: She ______ be in the office; I saw her car in the parking lot.
questions.explanation: 從車在停車場推斷她應該在辦公室，表現在的推測（幾乎確定），用 must。

questions.sentence: Employees ______ take at least one week of vacation per year.
questions.explanation: 表建議或規定（應該），用 should；must 為強制，can 為能力，might 為可能，皆過強或不符。

questions.sentence: He ______ have submitted the report; it's not in the system.
questions.explanation: 從系統中找不到報告推斷他不可能已提交，表過去的否定推測，用 can't have + 過去分詞。

questions.sentence: We ______ reschedule the meeting if everyone agrees.
questions.explanation: 表可能性或許可（可以），用 can；must 為義務，should have 為過去遺憾，need 單獨用法不自然。

questions.sentence: They ______ have informed us earlier about the change.
questions.explanation: should have + 過去分詞表示過去應該做但沒做，帶遺憾或批評語氣。

questions.sentence: Visitors ______ sign in at the reception desk.
questions.explanation: are required to 表示規定必須，為正式被動表達；其他選項表可能性，不符合強制規定語意。

questions.sentence: The system ______ be down; I can access it fine.
questions.explanation: 從我可以正常存取推斷系統不可能當機，否定推測用 can't。

questions.sentence: If the budget ______ approved, we will start the project.
questions.explanation: 第一條件句（可能發生的真實條件）：if 子句用現在式，故選 is。

questions.sentence: If I ______ the CEO, I would invest more in R&D.
questions.explanation: 第二條件句（假設非現實）：if 子句用 were（所有人稱），表示與現實相反的假設。

questions.sentence: If they ______ the market sooner, they would have avoided losses.
questions.explanation: 第三條件句（與過去事實相反）：if 子句用過去完成式 had entered，主句用 would have。

questions.sentence: Unless the payment ______, the order will be cancelled.
questions.explanation: unless = if not，條件子句用現在式（被動），表示若未收到款項，用 is received。

questions.sentence: Should you ______ any questions, please contact us.
questions.explanation: Should you have… 為省略 if 的倒裝條件句，相當於 If you should have…，動詞用原形 have。

questions.sentence: If the weather ______ better tomorrow, we will hold the event outdoors.
questions.explanation: 第一條件句，if 子句用現在式 is 表達真實條件。

questions.sentence: Had they ______ us earlier, we could have prepared better.
questions.explanation: Had they notified… 為省略 if 的第三條件句倒裝，動詞用過去分詞 notified。

questions.sentence: The candidate ______ was interviewed yesterday has ten years of experience.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為人（candidate），在關係子句中作主詞，用 who。

questions.sentence: The building in ______ we work was built in 1990.
questions.explanation: 介系詞 in 後接關係代名詞，先行詞為物（building），用 which。

questions.sentence: She is the manager ______ team won the annual award.
questions.explanation: 表所有關係，先行詞為人（manager），用 whose。

questions.sentence: The software ______ we use daily needs to be updated.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為物（software），在關係子句中作受詞，用 which（或 that）。

questions.sentence: This is the reason ______ we postponed the launch.
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 reason（原因），關係副詞用 why。

questions.sentence: Do you remember the day ______ we signed the contract?
questions.explanation: 先行詞為 day（時間），關係副詞用 when。

questions.sentence: The employee to ______ I gave the assignment is very reliable.
questions.explanation: 介系詞 to 後接受格關係代名詞，先行詞為人，用 whom。

questions.sentence: ______ the project was behind schedule, the team delivered excellent results.
questions.explanation: 表讓步（雖然進度落後但結果很好），用 Although。

questions.sentence: She studied hard ______ she could pass the exam.
questions.explanation: 表目的（為了能通過考試），用 so that。

questions.sentence: ______ the report is submitted, the team can take a break.
questions.explanation: Once = as soon as，表示一旦…就…，符合語意。

questions.sentence: He will not sign the contract ______ all terms are agreed upon.
questions.explanation: not…until 表示直到…才…，符合語意。

questions.sentence: The meeting was canceled ______ the main speaker was ill.
questions.explanation: 表原因（因為主講者生病），用 because。

questions.sentence: ______ working in finance, she has a degree in engineering.
questions.explanation: Despite + 名詞/動名詞，表讓步，後接 working（動名詞）；Although 後須接子句，不符。

questions.sentence: The product is expensive; ______, it sells very well.
questions.explanation: 表對比轉折（貴但賣得好），用連接副詞 however；therefore 表結果，because 表原因，so 為連接詞，皆不符。

questions.sentence: ______ the low budget, the event was a great success.
questions.explanation: Despite + 名詞片語（the low budget），表讓步；Although/Even if 後須接子句。

questions.sentence: She gave ______ informative speech at the conference.
questions.explanation: informative 以母音音素 /ɪ/ 開頭，用不定冠詞 an。

questions.sentence: ______ data from last quarter shows a 20% increase.
questions.explanation: 特指上一季的數據（雙方已知），用定冠詞 The。

questions.sentence: We need to make ______ progress on this issue.
questions.explanation: progress 為不可數名詞，前面不加冠詞（make progress 為固定片語）。

questions.sentence: He is ______ CEO of a major tech company.
questions.explanation: CEO 為唯一職位（公司只有一位），用定冠詞 the。

questions.sentence: Please send me ______ copy of the report.
questions.explanation: copy 以子音音素開頭，首次提及，用不定冠詞 a。

questions.sentence: ______ ability to communicate clearly is essential.
questions.explanation: 接 to communicate clearly 的修飾限定，特指這種能力，用 The。

questions.sentence: The manager decided ______ the project timeline.
questions.explanation: decide 後接不定詞（to + V），故選 to extend。

questions.sentence: They avoided ______ the issue during the meeting.
questions.explanation: avoid 後接動名詞（V-ing），故選 discussing。

questions.sentence: She is used to ______ long hours.
questions.explanation: be used to 中 to 為介系詞，後接動名詞，故選 working。

questions.sentence: He denied ______ the confidential document.
questions.explanation: deny 後接動名詞（V-ing），故選 leaking。

questions.sentence: We expect ______ the deal by the end of the month.
questions.explanation: expect 後接不定詞（to + V），故選 to close。

questions.sentence: The company considered ______ a new office in Asia.
questions.explanation: consider 後接動名詞（V-ing），故選 opening。

questions.sentence: She promised ______ the proposal by Friday.
questions.explanation: promise 後接不定詞（to + V），故選 to submit。

questions.sentence: They kept ______ until the problem was resolved.
questions.explanation: keep 後接動名詞（V-ing），表示持續做某事，故選 working。

questions.sentence: This product is ______ expensive than the previous model.
questions.explanation: 表比較（比…更不貴），用 less + 形容詞，less expensive 正確。

questions.sentence: The ______ you practice, the better you become.
questions.explanation: The + 比較級…the + 比較級 句型，more 為多音節副詞/形容詞的比較級，故選 more。

questions.sentence: Our new office is twice ______ as the old one.
questions.explanation: 倍數比較句型：倍數 + as + 原級 + as，故選 as large。

questions.sentence: She is by far the ______ qualified candidate.
questions.explanation: by far 強調程度，與最高級連用，最高級用 most，故選 most。

questions.sentence: This quarter's results are ______ worse than last quarter's.
questions.explanation: 修飾比較級用 much/far/even，不用 very，故選 much。

questions.sentence: The meeting will be held ______ Monday morning.
questions.explanation: 特定日期或星期幾用介系詞 on（on Monday morning）。

questions.sentence: Please submit the form ______ the end of the day.
questions.explanation: 表截止時間（不超過某時點），用 by；until 表持續到某時，不符。

questions.sentence: She has been working ______ this company ______ five years.
questions.explanation: work at a company（在某公司工作），for + 一段時間（for five years）。

questions.sentence: The report must be submitted ______ noon.
questions.explanation: 表截止時間，用 by（不超過中午前）。

questions.sentence: He is responsible ______ overseeing the entire project.
questions.explanation: be responsible for 為固定搭配，表示對…負責。

questions.sentence: The company is headquartered ______ Tokyo.
questions.explanation: 大城市或國家用介系詞 in（headquartered in Tokyo）。

questions.sentence: She graduated ______ business administration.
questions.explanation: graduate from 表示從某校或學系畢業，為固定搭配。

questions.sentence: Her ______ of the market trends was impressive.
questions.explanation: 所有格 Her 後接名詞，understanding 作名詞用（對…的理解），故選 understanding。

questions.sentence: The report provides ______ information about the market.
questions.explanation: 修飾名詞 information 需用形容詞，valuable 為形容詞，故選 valuable。

questions.sentence: The team worked ______ to meet the deadline.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 worked，需用副詞，tirelessly 為副詞，故選 tirelessly。

questions.sentence: There has been significant ______ in productivity this year.
questions.explanation: There has been + 名詞，improvement 為名詞，故選 improvement。

questions.sentence: Please ensure that all documents are ______ filed.
questions.explanation: 修飾過去分詞 filed，需用副詞，properly 為副詞，故選 properly。

questions.sentence: The manager made a ______ decision to restructure the team.
questions.explanation: 修飾名詞 decision，需用形容詞，bold 為形容詞，故選 bold。

questions.sentence: The project requires ______ coordination between departments.
questions.explanation: 修飾名詞 coordination，需用形容詞，effective 為形容詞，故選 effective。

questions.sentence: We need to ______ our operations to reduce costs.
questions.explanation: need to 後接動詞原形，streamline 為動詞，故選 streamline。

questions.sentence: The new policy has ______ affected employee morale.
questions.explanation: 修飾動詞 affected，需用副詞，positively 為副詞，故選 positively。

questions.sentence: His ______ in negotiation helped close the deal.
questions.explanation: 所有格 His 後接名詞，expertise 為名詞（專業知識），故選 expertise。

questions.sentence: Not only ______ he finish the report, but he also presented it.
questions.explanation: Not only 置於句首，助動詞前移（倒裝），表過去用 did；finish 恢復原形。

questions.sentence: It is the employees ______ make a company successful.
questions.explanation: It is…that… 為強調句型，固定用 that（強調主詞 the employees）。

questions.sentence: ______ does the company offer good salaries, but also great benefits.
questions.explanation: Not only…but also… 為固定句型，置於句首時助動詞前移。

questions.sentence: ______ is essential to build strong relationships with clients.
questions.explanation: It is + 形容詞 + to V 虛主詞句型，It 為形式主詞。

questions.sentence: Rarely ______ a product launch go so smoothly.
questions.explanation: 否定頻率副詞 Rarely 置句首，助動詞倒裝；主詞 a product launch 為第三人稱單數，用 does。

questions.sentence: ______ the project on time, she worked overtime every day.
questions.explanation: 表目的（為了準時完成），用不定詞 To complete 作目的副詞。

questions.sentence: ______ all requirements, the candidate was offered the position.
questions.explanation: 分詞構句，主詞與主句相同，表示同時進行或因果關係，用現在分詞 Meeting。

questions.sentence: The report indicates ______ sales have increased by 30%.
questions.explanation: indicate 後接 that 引導的名詞子句，表示陳述事實，用 that。

questions.sentence: ______ all the data, the analyst submitted the final report.
questions.explanation: 動作先於主句發生，用完成分詞構句 Having analyzed。

questions.sentence: I wonder ______ the client will accept our proposal.
questions.explanation: wonder 後接是否（yes/no 疑問）的名詞子句，用 whether。

questions.sentence: ______ in the lab, the scientist made an important discovery.
questions.explanation: 分詞構句，主詞（the scientist）正在工作時發現，用現在分詞 Working。

questions.sentence: The question is ______ we can afford the upgrade.
questions.explanation: The question is whether… 表示問題在於是否…，用 whether 引導名詞子句。

questions.sentence: The seminar is scheduled ______ 3 p.m. on Friday.
questions.explanation: 特定時刻用介系詞 at（at 3 p.m.）。

questions.sentence: This method is far ______ efficient than the old one.
questions.explanation: far 修飾比較級，more efficient 為正確比較級形式。
